text.description_html:
Fusion PH-T9, American Relic Series Southern Manor Toilet Tissue Wall Mount

The Southern Manor Toilet Paper Holder has old world charm by remaining true to the classic silhouettes of early American architecture. This wall-mounted toilet paper holder is easy to install and comes with all the necessary mounting hardware. A large toilet tissue holder, the PH-T9 made by Fusion can accommodate even the biggest of rolls.

Also Available Matching: Southern Manor Towel Bar, Southern Manor Towel Ring, and Southern Manor Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Southern Manor Trim Paper Holder:

  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Mount Length: 3-1/2"
  • Mount Projection: 1/2"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
